I'm exploring using Kurtosis to deploy a single cl and el node pair on a google kubernetes engine. The idea is to have others also deploy their own single GKE node pairs and we can connect and peer up using loadbalancer services. The issue I'm having is that the genesis file created differs when I run the kurtosis command to create this setup on a gke using github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package. I have narrowed the difference being caused by the *timestamp* field that is inserted by the ethereum-genesis-generator. Is there a way to use an already existing genesis file when spinning up a network using kurtosis? Thanks! Can you paste your config file here that you are running. We are not aware of any kubernetes bugs that would involve the timestamp fields also which timestamp field is incorrect ? The only supported method is currently to use a brand new network, an existing devnet (hosted by us), and existing testnet, like sepolia, hoodi or mainnet. <@412614104222531604> This is my kurtosis config file: ``` config-version: 2 should-send-metrics: true kurtosis-clusters: docker: type: "docker" minikube: type: "kubernetes" config: kubernetes-cluster-name: "minikube" storage-class: "standard" enclave-size-in-megabytes: 10 cloud: type: "kubernetes" config: kubernetes-cluster-name: "ethereum-cluster" storage-class: "standard" enclave-size-in-megabytes: 10000 ``` And this is my network parameter file: ``` participants: - el_type: geth el_log_level: "trace" cl_type: lighthouse cl_log_level: "trace" count: 1 network_params: network_id: "9223372036854" prefunded_accounts: '{"0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266":{ "balance": "10000000ETH" }}' additional_services: - dora ``` Sorry the timestamp is in the genesis file so it is for the creation of the genesis block. The only way then for a new network spun by kurtosis to have the same genesis file as another network spun by kurtosis is if somehow I can specify the genesis file to use when I call `kurtosis run`. I'm not sure if this is possible? no, not possible Alright thank you

excerpts.author: taku8797
excerpts.content:
Hi all! 

I'm exploring using Kurtosis to deploy a single cl and el node pair on a google kubernetes engine. The idea is to have others also deploy their own single GKE node pairs and we can connect and peer up using loadbalancer services. 

The issue I'm having is that the genesis file created differs when I run the kurtosis command to create this setup on a gke using github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package. I have narrowed the difference being caused by the *timestamp* field that is inserted by the ethereum-genesis-generator. 

Is there a way to use an already existing genesis file when spinning up a network using kurtosis?

Thanks!
